props.author: Ballard repair
props.imageAlt: What we repair and what we don't
paragraphs: We repair anything with a seam, a zip, a snap, or a coating: shells, bibs, fleece, waxed cotton, sweaters, packs, and duffels. Repairs on Ballard gear are free for the life of the gear. You pay shipping one way.
We don't repair socks, gloves, or boots. Socks and gloves wear through where they're supposed to. Boots are rubber, and a patched rubber boot leaks. When these wear out, they're worn out.
Turnaround is about two weeks from the day we receive it. Repairs done at the Fremont and Bellingham stores are usually faster. Bring it in, or start a repair request online.
